fields.Name: T192 - Admin ERD Zoom and Fit Controls
fields.Description: Exercises the SVG pan/zoom transform pipeline (zoomBy / fitToView / zoomPercent) unique to the ERD canvas — no other tested surface has an interactive zoomable canvas.

InputDefinition.goal: In MJ Explorer, switch to the Admin application via the application switcher dropdown next to the logo. Open 'Data & Schema' and open the ERD (Entity Relationship Diagram) viewer. Wait for the diagram to render — pages can take 10-30s in this resource-constrained environment, so wait and do NOT navigate away. In the diagram header top-right there is a zoom toolbar: a zoom-in (magnifying-glass-plus) button, a zoom-out (magnifying-glass-minus) button, a fit-to-view (expand) button, and a zoom-percentage readout. Click zoom-in once or twice, then click fit-to-view. Success is that the zoom-percentage readout changes in response to your clicks (increases on zoom-in) and the diagram re-scales/re-centers when you click fit-to-view. You do NOT need any particular zoom value.

judgeValidationCriteria: The ERD renders with a visible zoom toolbar (zoom in/out/fit) and a zoom-percent readout
Clicking zoom controls changes the zoom-percent readout and visibly re-scales the diagram; fit-to-view re-frames it
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
